description: Get IBM i services information from QSYS2.SERVICES_INFO

service_type.description: Filter by service type (HTTP, SOAP, etc.)

sql: SELECT SERVICE_NAME, SERVICE_TYPE, SERVICE_URL, SERVICE_PORT, SERVICE_DESCRIPTION, SERVICE_STATUS FROM QSYS2.SERVICES_INFO WHERE (SERVICE_NAME LIKE '%{{service_name}}%' OR '{{service_name}}' IS NULL) AND (SERVICE_TYPE = '{{service_type}}' OR '{{service_type}}' IS NULL) ORDER BY SERVICE_NAME FETCH FIRST {{limit}} ROWS ONLY
